mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: Passed through unchanged. It is one of the three GROUP BY columns. Expression: o.order_id.
mappings.notes: Part of the source PK (order_id, line_no), so it cannot be NULL. The result is sorted by this column.

mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: Sum of the line net prices per order. Line net = ROUND(qty * price * (1 - disc_pct), 2), rounded to the cent with ties away from zero. disc_pct = LEAST(vol_pct + tier_pct + promo_pct, 0.15). vol_pct: qty >= 50 gives 0.10, qty >= 20 gives 0.05, qty >= 10 gives 0.02, else 0. tier_pct: GOLD gives 0.05, SILVER gives 0.02, else 0. promo_pct: SAVE10 gives 0.10, SAVE5 gives 0.05, else 0. Expression: SUM(net).
mappings.notes: NULL when every line of the order has a NULL qty. Promo matching is exact and case-sensitive.

mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: Free shipping at 100 or more, otherwise a flat 9.99. Expression: CASE WHEN o.subtotal >= 100 THEN 0 ELSE 9.99 END.
mappings.notes: 9.99 and 100 are hardcoded. A NULL subtotal falls into the 9.99 branch. The two branches may display with different scales (UNKNOWN).

mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: Tax on goods plus shipping at the customer's province rate, rounded to the cent. Expression: ROUND((o.subtotal + shipping) * t.rate, 2), where shipping is the M03 expression.
mappings.notes: NULL when the subtotal is NULL. QC is seeded as 0.14975, which has more than the 4 decimals of numeric(5,4). What is stored depends on the engine (UNKNOWN).

mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: Profit as a percent of the goods total, excluding shipping and tax, to 1 decimal. Expression: ROUND((o.subtotal - o.total_cost) / NULLIF(o.subtotal, 0) * 100, 1), where total_cost = SUM(qty * cost).
mappings.notes: NULL when the subtotal is 0 or NULL. Line cost is not rounded.

mappings.target_table: UNKNOWN (result set of the final SELECT)
mappings.logic: If the unrounded margin ratio is below 0.10 then REVIEW else OK. Expression: CASE WHEN (o.subtotal - o.total_cost) / NULLIF(o.subtotal, 0) < 0.10 THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'OK' END.
mappings.notes: Uses the unrounded ratio, not margin_pct. A NULL ratio gives OK.

rules.name: Read all order lines
rules.expr: FROM order_line l (no WHERE or HAVING anywhere in the query)
rules.logic: Every order line is the starting set. There is no date, status or order filter.

rules.name: Attach customer
rules.logic: Brings in tier (loyalty discount) and province (tax). A line with a NULL or unknown customer_id is dropped silently.

rules.name: Attach product
rules.logic: Brings in price and cost. A line with a NULL or unknown sku is dropped silently.

rules.name: Order totals
rules.expr: GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, province; SUM(net) AS subtotal; SUM(line_cost) AS total_cost
rules.logic: One row per order, customer and province. If one order has lines for different customers, it comes out as several rows with the same order_id.

rules.name: Attach tax rate
rules.logic: Gets the tax rate. An order whose province is not in tax_rate (for example MB, or lowercase on) is dropped silently.

rules.name: Output sorted by order
rules.logic: The final SELECT only returns a result set. There is no INSERT or CREATE for a target, so nothing is saved. Ties on order_id have no defined order.
